variation_points.theme: palette tokens in the product design spec
variation_points.formulas: formula strings supplied as cell values
variation_points.row_counts: rows passed to the selected primitive
variation_points.screen_column_widths: inherited from the native master; only deliberate product variants may change them
variation_points.conditional_formatting: explicit product override after the base layout
variation_points.validation_lists: explicit list values attached to input columns
variation_points.table_schema: explicit semantic headers, stable ListObject ranges, totals outside data ranges
variation_points.number_formats: assign by field meaning after cloning; never inherit percentage formats blindly
variation_points.identity_asset: one product-specific SVG or palette-adapted variant embedded on every worksheet
